citations.headingPath: ISP › Section 9 › 9.3 Ransomware on the NAS, the processing workstations or DC-HPC project storage
citations.quote: Indicators: encrypted or renamed files, a ransom note, the NAS snapshot schedule disabled, processing scripts failing manifest checks, the client deliverable folder unreadable, DC-HPC project storage

snapshot.title: Final Environment Cleanse Confirmed — NAS & GCS-02

fields.subject: FW: HUOG-NAS01 and HUOG-PROC01 - Final Environment Cleanse Confirmation
fields.note:
The threat actor’s persistence mechanism has been fully contained. All access points to the Data VLAN have been blocked at HUOG-FW01. The offline backup drive OB-1 (10.17.60.17) has been verified as unmounted and not infected. The off-site backup service's last good snapshot is from 2026-04-10 22:15 (before the snapshot schedule was disabled). The environment is clean. You may proceed with recovery under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.

Action: Confirm that OB-1 is not connected until the Systems & Cybersecurity Lead verifies the drive’s integrity and the recovery plan is approved by the General Manager.
